questions.prompt: Flop As 7d 2c, turn 3h. For a preflop raiser who c-bet, this turn is mostly…

choices.text: A brick. It completes few draws and does not change the nuts.
A card that always gives the caller the nuts

questions.explanation: The three does not connect with ace-seven-deuce. Overpairs and top pair stay best.

questions.prompt: Flop Kh 7d 3c, turn Ah. What changed?

choices.text: An ace is now top pair, and a heart flush draw appeared.
The pot is awarded to the preflop raiser

questions.explanation: The ace leapfrogs kings. Anyone with the ace of hearts also picked up the nut flush draw.

choices.text: A turn that completes an obvious draw, such as a third flush card.
Only a card that pairs your hole card

questions.explanation: Scare cards shift the nuts toward the draw that just got there. Bluffing them without a blocker is how stations get paid.

questions.prompt: Who is hurt more when the third flush card comes and they have no flush?

choices.text: The player who was betting one pair for value. Their hand is now behind every flush.
Nobody. One pair still beats a flush
Only the player with the nuts

questions.explanation: One pair does not improve when the flush arrives. Value bets have to shrink or stop.
